How ThawVault Stretches Engagement to 2+ Hours

Three distinct stages. Three different instincts. One continuous enrichment session.

🔍

Stage 1

Forage & Discover

0–20 min

Dog sniffs, nudges, and paws through the silicone snuffle skirt to find hidden kibble. Engages natural foraging instincts — nose work burns mental energy fast.

  • 12–20 flexible silicone flaps (size-dependent)
  • Hides up to 1 cup of kibble or treats
  • Flaps return to position — no reset needed
  • Soft, quiet, paw-friendly material
🧊

Stage 2

Lick & Chill

20–60 min

Frozen broth, yogurt, or pumpkin in the insulated lick seal. Licking releases endorphins, calms anxiety, and the double-wall insulation keeps it frozen 2–3× longer than a bowl.

  • Vacuum-sealed gel core holds freeze 2+ hours
  • 1.5–4 cup capacity (size-dependent)
  • Textured surface prolongs licking
  • Removable for easy filling & cleaning
⚖️

Stage 3

Wobble & Unlock

60+ min

Bottom-weighted core wobbles unpredictably, dispensing 1–3 pieces per cycle. Dog learns to manipulate angle and force — problem-solving that sustains engagement past the freeze.

  • Self-righting weighted base (TPR + steel shot)
  • Adjustable dispensing difficulty
  • Works with kibble up to 15 mm
  • No electronics — pure physics

Questions? We've Got Answers

Everything you need to know about ThawVault, from freezer to floor.

How long does ThawVault keep my dog busy?

Most dogs engage for 1.5 to 2+ hours per session. The frozen lick seal extends licking time significantly, while the weighted core and snuffle skirt provide varied enrichment that prevents boredom.

What size should I get for my dog?

Small: under 15 kg / 33 lbs (terriers, puppies, small breeds). Medium: under 15 kg / 33 lbs but higher drive (border collies, cattle dogs). Large/Power Chewer: 15 kg+ / 33+ lbs OR any aggressive chewer regardless of size. When in doubt, size up.

Is ThawVault really zero electronics?

Yes. No batteries, no charging, no apps, no Bluetooth. Pure mechanical enrichment powered by thermodynamics (frozen core), physics (wobble mechanics), and instinct (foraging). It works anywhere — camping, travel, power outages.

What can I put in the frozen lick seal?

Any dog-safe liquid or semi-liquid: bone broth, plain yogurt, pumpkin puree, mashed banana, peanut butter thinned with water, wet food blended with water. Freeze 4+ hours for best results. The insulated chamber keeps it frozen 2-3 hours at room temp.

Is ThawVault dishwasher safe?

Yes, all components are top-rack dishwasher safe. The silicone skirt, lick seal, and core can all go in the dishwasher. The weighted core's TPR material withstands high heat. For the insulated seal, we recommend air drying upside down to prevent water trapping.
